ALLOCATION AND CAPITAL BY ERA | FY2018 - Q3 2026
G1-G6 | thesis -> allocation choices -> dated evidence
[I] Reinvest for merchant growth; reset costs; compound cash generation.
|
+-- EXPAND | 2018 - Q1 2020
|   +-- [S] Themes: platform, Plus, international, brand and products.
|   +-- [R] Revenue $1.07B -> $1.58B; GMV growth +56% -> +49%.
|   +-- [R] Opex 115-116% of gross profit; people 4,000+ -> 5,000+.
|   +-- [S] $30M brand campaign; suspended Q1 2020.
|   `-- [S] Q2 2019: $1B five-year fulfillment plan.
|
+-- SURGE | Q2 2020 - Q1 2021
|   +-- [R] GMV growth +46% Q1 2020 -> +119% Q2 2020.
|   +-- [I] Pandemic demand enlarged the opportunity; attribution is limited.
|   +-- [R] Merchant solutions revenue share rose 9.7 points in FY20.
|   `-- [R] 2020-21 equity and notes raised $5.1B gross.
|
+-- BUILD-AHEAD | Q2 2021 - Q2 2022
|   +-- [S] 2021 plan: reinvest substantially all gross profit.
|   +-- [S] GMV growth: 114% Q1 2021 -> 40% Q2 2021 -> 11% Q2 2022.
|   +-- [R] Operating margin +12.5% Q2 2021 -> -14.7% Q2 2022.
|   +-- [R] People 7,000+ -> 10,000+ during 2021.
|   `-- [S] 2022: aggressive hiring plan and Deliverr expansion.
|
+-- RECKONING | Q3 2022 - Q2 2023
|   +-- [R] Expected sustained ecommerce expansion did not materialize.
|   +-- [R] July 2022: about 10% workforce cut; Deliverr closes.
|   +-- [S] Sept 2022 Flex Comp; Jan-Apr 2023 standard-plan price rise.
|   +-- [R] May-June 2023: about 23% workforce cut; logistics sold.
|   +-- [R] FY22 operating loss $822M; opex 130% of gross profit.
|   `-- [R] FY23 operating loss $1.42B includes $1.34B impairment.
|
+-- FOCUSED COMPOUNDING | Q3 2023 - Q1 2025
|   +-- [S] Q4 opex/revenue: 52% FY22* -> 36% FY23 -> 32% FY24.
|   +-- [S] Q2 2024: fifth straight quarter of >=25% growth ex-logistics.
|   +-- [S] Marketing: tighter paybacks, then targeted reinvestment.
|   `-- [I] Margin reset and growth recovery overlap; no causal test.
|
+-- REACCELERATION | Q2 2025 onward
|   +-- [S] Q2 2025 GMV +31%; +29% at constant currency.
|   +-- [S] Q2 2026: fifth quarter of 29-30% constant-currency GMV growth.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2025 policy: assess AI before requesting more headcount.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026: revenue +32%; opex 32% of revenue.
|
+-- ALLOCATION | dollars, ratios and revenue mix
|   +-- [R] FY22->FY25: R&D +2%; S&M +35%; G&A -33%; revenue +106%.
|   +-- [X] Falling R&D and S&M ratios alone establish deprioritization.
|   `-- [X] Merchant solutions revenue share establishes spending priority.
|
+-- CAPITAL | raising -> deploying -> generating and returning
|   +-- [R] 2018-early 2021: $6.85B gross raised; treasury grew $6.83B.
|   +-- [R] FY22: $1.75B acquisitions; $635M equity investments.
|   +-- [R] FY23-25: $4.51B FCF; FY25 notes repaid $1.04B.
|   `-- [S] Up to $2B buyback authorized; execution not supplied.
|
+-- CASH QUALITY | distinguish cash generation from lending uses
|   +-- [R] FCF margin FY22/23/24/25: -3.3% / 12.8% / 18.0% / 17.4%.
|   +-- [I] After net lending: -6.2% / 5.4% / 12.8% / 12.4%.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026 FCF margin 22%; improvement only partly structural.
|
`-- DISCLOSURE | boundaries on what can be concluded
    +-- [R] Seed endpoints: same-merchant GMV FY19; exact merchant count FY21.
    `-- [I] Claimed disclosure endings require fuller coverage to verify.

* [S] FY22 Q4 excludes the real estate charge.
[R] filing/calculation; [S] management; [I] inference; [X] contradicted claim.
Links: M=structure, C=sequence, D=dependency; grade follows colon.
mech=arithmetic; data=management figure; claim=assertion; assoc=co-movement.
contra=contradiction; untestable=missing data; no causal links established.
